title.description: Municipality or body name from the registry.

entryUrl.description: The OParl System entry point that was checked.

httpStatus.description: HTTP status of the entry point, null when unreachable.

latencyMs.description: Measured response time of the entry point in milliseconds.

status.description: What the endpoint actually did. A 200 with an OParl Error object is error_object, not alive.

error.description: Why the endpoint failed, when it did.

oparlVersion.description: OParl version the system declares, e.g. 1.0 or 1.1.

systemName.description: Name the system reports for itself.

vendor.description: Vendor URL the system declares (more! Rubin, STERNBERG, Session/SessionNet, ...).

product.description: Product URL the system declares, when it does.

license.description: Licence the endpoint itself declares for its data, null when it declares none.

bodiesCount.description: Number of bodies (Körperschaften) the endpoint lists.

bodiesHttp.description: HTTP status of the bodies collection.

collections.description: Which OParl collections answered at the top level, with the number of items the first page returned.

collectionsScopedUnderBody.description: Body id whose collections were used when the top level serves none (measured: some vendors only answer under a body).

registry.description: Where this endpoint came from: the community registry URL or 'user input'.
